name: Backend Agent Benchmark
description: Curated agent-only backend core (47 cases) organized by category: NestJS (guards/pipes/interceptors/filters), a large synthetic SaaS API for retrieval-style grading, Express/legacy-CommonJS, a pnpm monorepo, robustness (ambiguous prompts, scope discipline, prompt-injection resistance), hand-rolled auth, and wide-blast-radius TypeScript type-cascade fixes.
